method: Static analysis of exact 1024 RGBA exported pixels: alpha>0.25 silhouette IoU, premultiplied RGBA mean absolute difference, alpha-weighted centroid, adjacent/last-to-first/cross-action transitions. No image modifications or alignment applied.
limits: Metrics locate changes; they neither prove unnatural motion nor replace actual playback. Cloth/light differences contribute heavily. No automatic pass/fail thresholds or anatomical classifications.
